pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with high-contrast, sharp edge gradients. Patch density increases and individual spatial area decreases towards the ventral and lower neck regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pelage pathways forming tri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness is generally uniform across the flank but exhibits narrowing in the ventral-chest transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the neck line, transitioning to a smoother profile over the shoulder hump.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A visible structural thinning in the mane continuity is present at the transition point between the upper neck and the shoulder ridge.
